text:
olivia-pr: Quick pulse — is the press kit final? Need green on embargo window + the analyst FAQ pack. Also pinging availability for briefings Thu/Fri.

simon-product: Do we have a single embargo time or split EU/US? Need to know for benchmark narrative callouts.

ana-marketing: Embargo plan proposed: lift at 11:00 PT for US; EU folks can embargo-until 20:00 UTC so they can cover in their morning. Is that OK with PR/legal?

kevin-ops: Legal sign-off pending one line about customer names. If TechCrunch asks for additional review window we might have to extend embargo by 2 hours. Heads-up.

press-bot: Embargo reminder: proposed lift 11:00 PT / 20:00 UTC. Please confirm by EOD. :bell:

jules-sales: FYI sales needs a short demo signup link in the kit — otherwise inbound routing will be messy. Can we add a GTM link to the press kit?

evan-press: Draft quote suggestions below — pls edit.
```
"We built Redwood Inference to make production LLM serving predictable at scale — delivering low latency and clear unit economics for engineering teams." — Chris (co-founder)
```
Would prefer something shorter for press.

maria-analyst-relations: Availability: I can brief APAC Fri morning, EU Fri afternoon, US Thu afternoon. I need the FAQ pack with 10-12 Qs by tomorrow noon to prep. Also please include the benchmark methodology appendix (short bullets).

olivia-pr: Action items: 1) ana — confirm embargo split and update press-bot 2) kevin — confirm legal clip about customer names by 4pm 3) evan — trim quote to one sentence and drop into kit 4) jules — add demo signup link we can track 5) maria — we'll send FAQ draft by 11:30am. I'll follow up with the reporter list. :thumbsup:

ana-marketing: Confirmed — embargo split ok. Updating press kit now and adding EU note.

kevin-ops: Legal okay with redaction clause. No extension required unless TC asks for co-review.

evan-press: Trimmed and uploaded quote to press kit: https://redwood.ai/presskit/preview (please confirm)

jules-sales: Demo signup link added: https://cal.com/redwood-demo (utm=press). Routing rule: all cal signups tagged "press" go to inbound-sales queue.

maria-analyst-relations: Got it — will review FAQ draft when it's up. Confirming briefing slots: Thu 3pm PT (US), Fri 9am GMT (EU).

olivia-pr: Perfect — final checklist: press kit link, quote, demo link, FAQ pack, embargo times. I’ll send final confirmation to the reporter cohort at 5pm PT. Thanks all. :rocket:
